basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: Qualification: The nurse should have minimum qualification of ANM from recognized University/Institution or registered in U.P. Nursing Council. Those with Diploma nursing/Bachelor of Science (Nursing) would be preferred. Experienced candidate would be preferred. Experience: Experienced candidate would be preferred Age limit: 18 to 40 years | Other conditions: | Registration certificate of U.P. salary_details.pay_scale: ANM Rs. 18,000 and Staff Nurse Rs. 21,000 per month (honorarium)

how_to_apply: Write the application on plain paper in the format given on page 2 of the notice.
Write post name and office name at top, then name, father/husband name, date of birth, permanent and correspondence address, mobile number, e-mail, caste and educational details.
Attach self-attested copies of registration certificate, experience certificate, passport size photo and related certificates.
Write the post applied for and office name in capital letters on the envelope.
Send by registered post to the Office of Chief Medical Superintendent, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Government Hospital, Varanasi between 16.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 by 5 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after 30.11.2026, 5 PM will not be considered Incomplete application may be rejected All original records must be brought at the interview No travel allowance of any kind for the interview

content_sections.text: Contract appointment till 31 March 2027; time limit may be extended further as per rules Extension only after approval of Government of India/competent level U.P. State AIDS Control Society, Lucknow may terminate service on any adverse fact with one month's notice or one month's pay

content_sections.text: Interview by selection committee Selection committee may consider experience etc. in addition to interview marks Decision of the committee will be final

Attach self-attested copies of registration certificate, experience certificate, passport size photo and related certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DDUGH Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DDUGH Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for ANM/Staff Nurse (OST Centre).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DDUGH Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format on page 2 of the notice) and send it to Office of the Chief Medical Superintendent, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Government Hospital, Varanasi, by registered post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ANM Rs. 18,000 and Staff Nurse Rs. 21,000 per month (honorarium).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum ANM from a recognised University/Institution or registered in U.P. Nursing Council; Diploma Nursing/B.Sc. (Nursing) and experienced candidates preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration certificate of U.P. State Medical Faculty to be enclosed with the application.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview by selection committee. Selection committee may consider experience etc. in addition to interview marks. Decision of the committee will be final.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract appointment till 31 March 2027; time limit may be extended further as per rules. Extension only after approval of Government of India/competent level. U.P. State AIDS Control Society, Lucknow may terminate service on any adverse fact with one month's notice or one month's pay.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: OST Centre, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay Government Hospital, Varanasi.
